finding: Parent search fires on every keystroke with no debounce, causing excessive API calls on each character typed. The student search above (line 54) correctly uses a 300ms debounce.

finding: Instructor combobox starts as null and is never pre-populated from team.coach_id. User must re-select the instructor every time they edit. If user saves without touching the instructor field, the lack of coach_id in the PATCH body may overwrite the existing coach_id depending on server merge semantics.

Uses an inline query key ['student', studentId, 'teams'] instead of the centralized queryKeys system. Cross-module cache invalidation (e.g., from other hooks or components) cannot target this query via the centralized keys.
getTeamsWithMembers is an exact duplicate of getTeams (same implementation, same URL, same params) and is never imported or called anywhere in the codebase.
Three sequential await queryClient.invalidateQueries() calls that could run in parallel for better performance.
before:
await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.competitionSummary(numericId) })
await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.competitionCategories(numericId) })
await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.teams })
after:
await Promise.all([
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.competitionSummary(numericId) }),
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.competitionCategories(numericId) }),
  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.teams }),
])

finding: parseInt(competitionId, 10) on potentially empty string yields NaN. While all consuming hooks guard with enabled: !!id (false for NaN), this is a latent hazard that should use a validated numeric ID.
before:
const competitionId = id || ''
const numericId = parseInt(competitionId, 10)
after:
const competitionId = id || ''
const numericId = competitionId ? parseInt(competitionId, 10) : 0
